objective: Preallocate foreign-key table scan data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate foreign-key data prefixes
tasks.result: Foreign-key table value scans now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in foreign-key table_has_column_values scan prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, row-cache lookups, row decoding, FK child/parent checks, COPY constraint checks, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused FK tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
